host.description: Host interface to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::1').

user.description: Username for HTTP Basic Auth (leave empty to disable auth).

pass.description: Password for HTTP Basic Auth (leave empty to disable auth).

allowed_ips.description: List of allowed IPs in CIDR notation; empty list allows all. Each item must be a string in valid CIDR format (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24').

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate (required if ssl=true).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key (required if ssl=true).

base_path.description: Base URL path (e.g., '/' or '/web'); must start with '/'.

idle_timeout.description: Timeout for idle connections in seconds.
